content.rendered: A high-risk merchant is a business that carries more risk for banks and payment processors. High-risk merchants have unique needs that are different from traditional or low-risk merchants. TailoredPay has the tools, resources, and expertise to provide high-quality payment processing services to high-risk merchants.
